description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for git archive attribute handling. It sets up a git repository, configures attributes, performs various archive operations, and verifies expected inclusion or exclusion of files and attributes.

methods.name: extract_tar_to_dir
methods.description: Extracts a tar archive into a specified directory, creating the directory if necessary.

methods.name: test_expect_exists
methods.description: Checks that a given file exists after a specified operation.

methods.name: test_expect_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given file does not exist after a specified operation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a command sequence.
